location_description: Trinity is a census-designated place (CDP) in Pasco County, Florida, United States.  The population was 10,907 in 2010, according to the most recent census. The Trinity Community is named after Trinity College of Florida, a Bible college founded in 1932, when it relocated to the first occupied site in the communities developed by James Gills in the late 1980s.
